name: jordan-final
plants: Nothing. The finalized resume is true, so every line must be supported by a quote from Jordan's profile and stories, never from the resume itself.

name: changed-number
plants: One number changed: the no-show rate fell from 18%, written as 28%.
mustFlag: Launched text reminders across 120 clinics, cutting the no-show rate from 28% to 11% within 6 months.

name: inflated-ownership
plants: "Partnered with payments engineering" became "Led payments engineering".
mustFlag: Led payments engineering on smart retries for soft-declined cards, raising authorization rate from 88.4% to 90.9% and recovering an estimated $4.2M in annual merchant sales.

name: wrong-role
plants: The digital wallets launch, which belongs to the Senior Product Manager job, moved into the Product Manager job at Wrenfield Health.
mustFlag: Rolled out Apple Pay and other digital wallets, training 40 support and sales reps; wallets reached 27% of mobile orders within 2 months.

name: keyword-list-summary
plants: One summary sentence rewritten as a string of keywords. Every word in it is a true skill; the sentence says nothing Jordan did.
mustFlag: Checkout and payments, conversion, A/B testing, funnel analysis, product roadmaps, cross-functional launches, enablement, KPI reporting.
